moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season is underway with Matchweek 1 fixtures taking place across the weekend, featuring all the big clubs.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Thrills
angles.copy: Premier League is BACK! Matchweek 1 continues today and tomorrow with Hull City v Man Utd, Newcastle v Liverpool and more. Who are you backing for the first three points?

angles.name: Big Games Ahead
angles.copy: After Arsenal's Friday night win, the Premier League opening weekend rolls on. Catch Everton, Man City, Chelsea and Spurs all in action before Monday. Pure football fever!

moments.title: Notting Hill Carnival Returns
moments.blurb: Europe's largest street festival, Notting Hill Carnival, takes over West London this August Bank Holiday weekend (Aug 29-31), celebrating 60 years of Caribbean culture, music, and dance.

angles.name: Carnival Countdown
angles.copy: Get ready for the biggest street party in Europe! Notting Hill Carnival kicks off next weekend, bringing incredible vibes, music, and colour to London. Who's going?

angles.name: 60 Years of Culture
angles.copy: Notting Hill Carnival is celebrating 60 years! From steel bands to vibrant parades, it's an unmissable Bank Holiday event. Expect serious energy.

moments.title: Happy 31st, Dua Lipa!
moments.blurb: British pop sensation Dua Lipa, known for hits like 'New Rules' and 'Levitating', celebrates her 31st birthday today.

angles.name: Pop Queen's Day
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 31st birthday to the incredible Dua Lipa! We're celebrating with a playlist of her biggest bangers all day.

angles.name: Future Nostalgia Birthday
angles.copy: She's got new rules and a new year! Happy 31st to Dua Lipa. What's your favourite track from the pop superstar?

moments.title: GZA Turns 60
moments.blurb: Gary Grice, better known as GZA or The Genius, a founding member of the legendary hip-hop group Wu-Tang Clan, celebrates his 60th birthday today.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 60th to the one and only GZA of Wu-Tang Clan! Still dropping knowledge and legendary rhymes. What's your favourite GZA track?

angles.name: Wu-Tang Forever
angles.copy: The Genius is 60 today! Celebrate the birthday of Wu-Tang Clan's GZA with us. Respect to a true hip-hop pioneer.

moments.title: Howie Dorough is 53
moments.blurb: Howie Dorough, member of the iconic 90s boy band Backstreet Boys, celebrates his 53rd birthday today.

angles.name: Backstreet's Back... For a Birthday!
angles.copy: Larger than life and 53 today! Happy Birthday to Howie Dorough of the Backstreet Boys. Which BSB song takes you back?

angles.name: Boyband Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 53rd birthday to Backstreet Boy, Howie Dorough! Celebrating the pop icon all day long.

moments.title: Tori Amos Turns 63
moments.blurb: Acclaimed singer-songwriter and pianist Tori Amos, known for her distinctive voice and powerful lyrics, celebrates her 63rd birthday today.

angles.name: Alt-Rock Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to the incredible Tori Amos! Her unique sound and lyrical depth have inspired generations. What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Roland Orzabal is 65
moments.blurb: Roland Orzabal, co-founder, guitarist, and vocalist of the iconic new wave band Tears for Fears, celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Tears For Fears Birthday
angles.copy: Shout out to Roland Orzabal of Tears for Fears, celebrating his 65th birthday! Still ruling the charts and our hearts. What's your favourite TFF hit?

moments.title: Chrissy Costanza Turns 30

angles.name: Pop-Rock Birthday
angles.copy: Tomorrow, Chrissy Costanza of Against The Current turns 30! Get ready to celebrate the pop-rock powerhouse.

angles.name: Madchester Legend's Birthday

angles.name: New Wave Icon
angles.copy: On Sunday, the brilliant Elvis Costello turns 72! Dive into his incredible back catalogue with us. What's your favourite album?

angles.name: KISS Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: You wanted the best, you got the best! Happy 77th Birthday to KISS's own Demon, Gene Simmons, this Sunday! Rock on!

angles.name: Garbage Frontwoman's Birthday

angles.name: Soul Legend's Milestone
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 80th birthday to the incredible Valerie Simpson this Monday! Her contributions to soul and R&B are immeasurable.

angles.name: Queen of Country Pop

angles.name: Happy 40th, Florence!

angles.name: Trance Icon's Birthday

angles.name: The Belfast Cowboy's Birthday

moments.title: UK Weather Outlook: Mild & Sunny
moments.blurb: The UK can expect generally mild temperatures and sunny intervals over the next week, with conditions warming towards the Bank Holiday weekend in London.

angles.name: Summer Sunshine Ahead
angles.copy: Looks like a pretty pleasant week across the UK! Expect sunny spells and mild temperatures, perfect for getting out and about. Enjoy!

angles.name: Bank Holiday Warm-Up
angles.copy: The Bank Holiday weekend is set to bring some warmer weather, especially for London. Get those outdoor plans ready!
